responsibility: Declares LRA’s internal data structures, globals, and inline utilities shared by the LRA subpasses. It defines pseudo live ranges, copy records, per-register state, operand and insn-recognition metadata, iteration counters, and helper routines for class changes, duplicate operand updates, value/offset tracking, and access to assignment/live-range services. It is the private coordination header for constraints, lives, assignment, elimination, spills, rematerialization, and coalescing, distinct from the small external lra.h interface.
